title: X.G200 Flow TC-2

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Nexx X.G200 Flow TC-2 is crafted for daily urban navigators conquering dense traffic. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at 1421g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~85 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Round Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Retro-styled full face with modern composite shell technology.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; TC-2 shell offers a slightly lower profile fit compared to standard TC-1.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Nexx X.G200 Flow TC-2: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Nexx X.G200 Flow TC-2: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide

introduction: Positioned in Nexx's Full Face lineup, the X.G200 Flow TC-2 brings Portuguese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Round Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Nexx X.G200 Flow TC-2 represents Nexx's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to a Round Oval head shape, the Nexx X.G200 Flow TC-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
